blind.description: A wooden trestle table covered with a cream cloth runner, functioning as a tailor's or haberdasher's merchandise display. On top are five large cylindrical bolts of rolled cloth (red, mustard yellow, forest green, off-white, and navy blue), four matching neat stacks of folded fabric in the front, two wooden thread spools with wrapped cord, and a green fedora hat displayed on a wooden millinery block stand. Geometry is clean and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular layout with a row of five colorful fabric rolls spanning across the back, rectangular folded cloth piles and two circular spools along the front edge, and a circular green brimmed hat on the far right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-height (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall) and roughly 4.5 feet wide.
